$comment: Monosai grammar difficulty presets. Authored for Monosai and dedicated to the public domain (CC0-1.0). Presets are the only grammar profile surface; see docs/decisions/0008-grammar-profile-presets.md and docs/decisions/0014-remove-grammar-rule-catalog.md. Names never contain a JLPT level; the caption records where patterns are conventionally taught. Japanese patterns are written literally as prose sent to the model.

presets.captionEn: the first patterns in any course
presets.descriptionEn: Single short sentences, one idea each.
presets.exampleJa: 私は毎朝七時に起きます。
presets.exampleEn: I get up at seven every morning.
presets.promptGuidance: Target ceiling: below JLPT N5, suitable for a learner's first few weeks. Sentence shape: one short clause of roughly 6-14 characters expressing one concrete idea; never join clauses. Available constructions: polite です／ではありません, polite non-past 〜ます／〜ません, は・が・を・に・で・と・も・の・か, 〜があります／〜います, and adjectives as predicates. Avoid: past tense, て-form, 〜たい, 〜から, 〜とき, conditionals, potential, passive, causative, volitional, relative clauses, and conjunctions. Subject matter: concrete and physical.

presets.descriptionEn: Short sentences that can join two ideas.
presets.exampleJa: 朝ごはんを食べてから、学校へ行きました。
presets.exampleEn: After eating breakfast, I went to school.
presets.promptGuidance: Target ceiling: roughly JLPT N5. Sentence shape: short sentences of about 10-20 characters with one clause, or at most two simply joined clauses. Available constructions: all starter forms plus plain and polite past, plain negative, て-form joining and 〜てください／〜ています／〜てもいいです, 〜たい, causal 〜から, contrastive 〜が／〜けれど, 〜とき, 〜だけ, basic comparison, 〜ことができます, 〜なければなりません, and change with 〜になります／〜くなります. Avoid: passive, causative, volitional, 〜ば／〜たら／〜なら conditionals, and relative clauses modifying nouns.

presets.descriptionEn: Ordinary writing with conditionals and describing clauses.
presets.exampleJa: 友達に借りた本を読んでみたら、思ったより面白かった。
presets.exampleEn: When I tried reading the book I borrowed from a friend, it was more interesting than I expected.
presets.promptGuidance: Target ceiling: roughly JLPT N4. Sentence shape: one or two clauses, usually 15-35 characters. Available constructions: simpler forms plus 〜たら／〜ば／〜と／〜なら conditionals, potential and volitional, giving and receiving, 〜ておく／〜てしまう／〜てみる, basic conjecture, 〜ながら／〜ので／〜のに／〜し, short relative clauses, experience, advice, excess, and ease or difficulty. Avoid: formal written connectives such as 〜において or 〜に基づいて, and literary or strongly idiomatic patterns.

presets.descriptionEn: Longer sentences that explain, compare, and reason.
presets.exampleJa: 友達に貸した本がまだ返ってこないので、少し心配しています。
presets.exampleEn: The book I lent my friend still has not come back, so I am a little worried.
presets.promptGuidance: Target ceiling: roughly JLPT N3. Sentence shape: up to three clauses, usually 25-50 characters; abstract or explanatory content is allowed. Available constructions: simpler forms plus 〜わけだ／〜ものだ／〜べきだ, stronger conjecture and certainty, purpose and manner, 〜によって／〜に対して／〜について／〜として, cause and blame, time relations, tendencies, necessity, lack of alternatives, and additive emphasis. Avoid: heavily formal patterns such as 〜を問わず or 〜にもかかわらず and literary forms such as 〜ゆえに or 〜べく.

presets.descriptionEn: Written and formal style, with nested description.
presets.exampleJa: 調査結果に基づいて計画を見直すことになったものの、現場の反発は小さくなかった。
presets.exampleEn: Although the plan was to be revised based on the survey results, resistance on the ground was not small.
presets.promptGuidance: Target ceiling: roughly JLPT N2. Sentence shape: longer sentences and nested modification are allowed when they remain clear. Available constructions: simpler forms plus formal relations and reference, basis and alignment, mediation and topic framing, concession, contrast, progression, consequence, possibility of harm, difficulty, social constraint, justification, and expectation contrast, including common N2 patterns such as 〜において, 〜に基づいて, 〜を問わず, and 〜にもかかわらず. Avoid: classical or literary forms such as 〜ゆえに, 〜べく, 〜ごとき, and 〜や否や.

presets.descriptionEn: No ceiling; literary and idiomatic writing is available.
presets.exampleJa: 彼は周囲の反対をものともせず、決めた道を歩き続けた。
presets.exampleEn: Undaunted by the opposition around him, he kept walking the path he had chosen.
presets.promptGuidance: Target ceiling: unrestricted, roughly JLPT N1 and below. Sentence shape: choose length and clause nesting to serve clarity, rhythm, and the story. Available constructions: the full range of modern Japanese, including literary and idiomatic patterns where genuinely natural. Patterns such as 〜ゆえに, 〜べく, 〜ごとき, 〜や否や, 〜なり, 〜そばから, 〜をものともせず, 〜に足る, and 〜と相まって are available but never required. Avoid: ornamental complexity, forced idioms, or grammar used only to display difficulty.

registerGuidance.spoken: Prefer casual spoken register, including contractions, where the scene allows.
